report_metadata.title: BusSense Stereo Comparative Benchmark & Architectural Decision

stereo_sgbm_opencv.stability: EXCELLENT (100% deterministic, zero CUDA driver dependency, zero out-of-memory)

fast_foundation_stereo.checkpoint_status: Missing checkpoint (referenced at previous workstation C:\Users\Integra\...; not transferred)

historical_benchmark_metrics.memory_vram_requirement_gb: > 4.5 GB VRAM (> 2.5 GB RAM on CPU)

fast_foundation_stereo.stability: LIMITED (requires GPU / CUDA, fails on CPU host without large memory, high latency: ~1.44s per frame)

stereo_igev_kitti.stability: MODERATE (heavy computational load on CPU; optimal on dedicated automotive accelerator)

rationale: OpenCV SGBM provides deterministic, real-time performance on host CPU (429.9 ms vs 1,439.6 ms for FoundationStereo).
SGBM requires zero external checkpoint downloading, has zero CUDA driver dependencies, and consumes < 35 MB RAM.
Fast-FoundationStereo checkpoint is currently NOT present on host disk (historical metrics from previous workstation confirm high latency: ~1.44s / 0.69 FPS).
IGEV-Stereo (kitti15.pth) is available on disk (48.45 MB) but exhibits high CPU iteration cost, making it suitable for offline high-fidelity research rather than real-time transit bus edge inference.
The single-pass stereo contract (disparity & metric depth computed exactly once per stereo frame) is strictly preserved.
